verdict.rationale: Linear says its public GraphQL API is the same API it uses internally to build its own apps, which strongly implies UI-API parity. Introspection of the full schema, a published SDL, a typed SDK, OAuth/API-key auth, webhooks, file upload and documented rate limits and deprecations add to that. missing for 10: an explicit statement or independent hands-on confirmation that every UI feature is reachable via the API, and evidence that newer surfaces like Loops and coding sessions are exposed via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.
Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.
